WORKING NOTES — ticket routing
Options: A standard queue, B priority desk, C regional office.
Evidence: REQ-2400–2409.

Confirmed valid:
- REQ-2408: small shipment, north region, from Regional Ops -> C accepted. Only successful assignment so far.

Confirmed invalid:
- C rejected for: large claim south (REQ-2400, REQ-2407); small claim north (REQ-2402, REQ-2403); large shipment east (REQ-2404); small shipment east (REQ-2405); large refund east (REQ-2409).
- B rejected for: large refund south (REQ-2401, REQ-2406).

No evidence yet for A. Do not assume A is invalid or valid.

Useful rules:
- Avoid C for claims, and for shipments/refunds outside the confirmed north-small-shipment case.
- Avoid B for large refunds from the south.
- Sender role may matter: REQ-2408 came from Regional Ops. “Came through regional office” alone is not sufficient (REQ-2405, C rejected).
- Phrases like “second attempt” or “client asking twice” do not determine routing.

Future:
- Small shipment, north, Regional Ops: C is confirmed.
- Large refund, south: avoid B; consider A/untested.
- Claims north/south: avoid C.
- Shipments/refunds east: avoid C.
- Track A outcomes next.

WORKING NOTES — ticket routing
Options: A standard, B priority, C regional. Evidence REQ-2400–2419.

Confirmed valid:
- C: REQ-2408 small shipment, north, Regional Ops.
- A: REQ-2410 small claim, east, Regional Ops; REQ-2418 small claim, south, Regional Ops; REQ-2419 small shipment, south, Regional Ops.

Confirmed invalid:
- A rejected: REQ-2411 large invoice north Field Sales; REQ-2412 large shipment north Finance; REQ-2414 large invoice east Field Sales; REQ-2416 large shipment south Finance; REQ-2417 small shipment east Client Services.
- B rejected: large refund south (2401, 2406); large claim east (2413 Finance, 2415 Field).
- C rejected: claims (2400, 2402, 2403, 2407); shipments/refunds east (2404, 2405, 2409).

Rules:
- Sender role matters most. A accepted only from Regional Ops so far; A rejected for all non-Regional Ops tested. Do not use A for Field Sales, Finance Desk, or Client Services without new evidence.
- C only confirmed for small shipment north from Regional Ops. Avoid C for claims and for east shipments/refunds.
- B invalid for large refund south and large claim east. Other B cases untested.
- Phrases like “second attempt,” “client asking twice,” or “through regional office” are not decisive.
- Invoices are new; A invalid for large invoice north/east.

Future:
- Regional Ops small claim/shipment: try A; north small shipment: C confirmed.
- Non-Regional Ops: avoid A; test B/C cautiously.
- Large invoice north/east: avoid A; test B/C.
- Large shipment north/south: avoid A; test B/C.
- Small shipment east: A and C invalid; test B.
- Large claim east: B invalid; A/C untested, but C generally bad for claims.
Track B/C outcomes next.

WORKING NOTES — ticket routing
Options: A standard, B priority, C regional, D (new; role unclear). Evidence REQ-2400–2429.

Confirmed valid:
- A: Regional Ops small claim east/south; small shipment south; small refund east (2421).
- B: Regional Ops small shipment east (2428).
- C: Regional Ops small shipment north (2408).
- D: Partner Accounts small invoice east (2423).

Confirmed invalid:
- A rejected: Regional Ops small claim north (2420); Regional Ops small invoice east (2427); large invoice north/east; large shipment north/south; small shipment east. Also all non-Regional Ops tested.
- B rejected: large refund south; large claim east/south/north; large shipment north.
- C rejected: claims generally; east shipments/refunds; large refund north (2424).
- D rejected: large claim south (2426).

Rules:
- Sender role matters, but Regional Ops does not make A always valid. A works for small claim east/south, small shipment south, small refund east; not small claim north, not invoices.
- Invoices: A is invalid for all tested. D confirmed only for Partner Accounts small invoice east. Test B/C otherwise.
- Large claims: B invalid across east/south/north. C generally bad for claims. D invalid for large claim south.
- Small shipment east: A and C invalid; B valid from Regional Ops.
- Large shipment north: A and B invalid; C untested.
- Large refund north: C invalid.
- Phrases like “second attempt,” “client asking twice,” “scanned, not typed,” “same as last month” are not decisive.

Future:
- Regional Ops small claim north: avoid A; test B/C cautiously.
- Regional Ops small refund east: A confirmed.
- Partner Accounts small invoice east: D confirmed.
- Small invoice east from Regional Ops: avoid A; test B/C/D.
- Large claim: avoid B; C likely bad; test A/D cautiously.
- Large shipment north: avoid A/B; test C.
Track B/C/D outcomes next.

WORKING NOTES — ticket routing, REQ-2400–2439
Options: A standard, B priority, C regional, D role/region-specific (not just Partner Accounts).

Confirmed valid:
- A: Regional Ops small claim east/south; small shipment south; small refund east.
- B: small shipment east from Regional Ops and Partner Accounts.
- C: Regional Ops small shipment north.
- D: Partner Accounts small invoice east; Field Sales large invoice east; Finance Desk large claim north.

Confirmed invalid:
- A: Regional Ops small claim north; Regional Ops small invoice east; large invoice north/east; large shipment north/south; small shipment east; all non-Regional Ops tested.
- B: large refund south; large claim east/south/north; large shipment north; Regional Ops small invoice south.
- C: claims generally; east shipments/refunds; large refund north; invoices north/south (small and large).
- D: large claim south; Partner Accounts small refund north.

Rules:
- A is not valid for invoices. B is invalid for Regional Ops small invoice south. C is invalid for invoices north/south. D can work for invoices: Partner Accounts small east, Field Sales large east. Test B/D for other invoices.
- Large claims: B bad east/south/north; C likely bad; D works Finance Desk north but not south. Test A/D cautiously.
- Small shipment east: A/C invalid; B valid.
- Large shipment north: A/B invalid; C untested.
- Large refund north: C invalid.
- Phrases like “second attempt,” “client asking twice,” “scanned, not typed,” “same as last month,” “no rush” are not decisive.

Future:
- Regional Ops small claim north: avoid A; test B/C cautiously.
- Partner Accounts small invoice east: D confirmed.
- Regional Ops small refund east: A confirmed.
- Large claim north: D confirmed for Finance Desk.
- Large invoice east: D confirmed for Field Sales; C invalid.
- Track B/C/D outcomes next.

WORKING NOTES — ticket routing, REQ-2400–2459

- B: large refund south; large claim east/south/north; large shipment north; Regional Ops small invoice south; Partner Accounts small shipment south.
- C: claims generally; east shipments/refunds; large refund north; invoices north/south; large shipment north.
- D: Field Sales large claim east/south; Partner Accounts small refund north; Finance Desk large shipment east; Field Sales large invoice east; Partner Accounts large invoice east; Partner Accounts small invoice south; Finance Desk large invoice south; Partner Accounts large shipment north.

Rules:
- A is not valid for invoices. C is not valid for invoices north/south. B works Finance Desk large invoice east; test A/B/C for others.
- Large claims: B bad east/south/north; C bad; A works Field Sales south/east; D works Finance Desk north and Field Sales north, but not Field Sales east/south.
- Small shipment east: B valid; A/C invalid.
- Large shipment north: A/B/C invalid; D invalid for Partner Accounts, so no valid option seen.
- Regional Ops small refund: B valid north; A invalid east; test B/C/D for east.
- Large refund: B valid east; C invalid north; B invalid south.

Future:

- Large invoice east/south: D invalid; B valid Finance Desk east; test A/B/C for other roles.
- Track B/C/D for remaining shipment/claim/invoice combinations.
